## Reviews
- Code review traced route/symbol identity, value boundaries, returns, and lookup compatibility from compiler records through CLI, story, map, router, and entity pages. No in-scope defect remained after focused and browser testing.
- Security review confirmed the task adds no write surface, renders repository prose as text nodes/native links, keeps encoded entity routing, and passes the package production dependency audit with zero vulnerabilities.
- Simplification review confirmed the temporary payload model and 420-line fallback ladder were removed; CLI, story, map, and JSON now share one semantic contract and existing recursive renderers.

## Deviations from plan
- Added a small shared human CLI formatter so tests can verify the CLI projection without spawning a process.
- Extended the semantic index's existing request-assignment and JSDoc-object handling after the real card fixture exposed those source-backed gaps; this was required to preserve complete structures without browser inference.
- Added flow-card link styling in the existing story stylesheet so linked technical prose wraps naturally on phone widths.

## Discovered issues
- Generic client `.post('/api/...')` helpers can still resemble server route registrations without a proven server router. Captured in intake as `route-discovery-still-treats-some-generic-client`.

## Open risks
- Static analysis intentionally leaves dynamic dispatch and unresolved callbacks outside resolved flow edges; users see analyzer limitations and would notice an absent edge rather than a fabricated one.
- The remaining generic client-helper route false positive is visible in intake and analyzer limitations; it does not alter the source-backed flow values delivered here.
